llm_response.reason: The website displays multiple scam characteristics: (1) no mention of a real company, owner, address, or legal entity; (2) an overly generic, ambiguous privacy policy with little real information; (3) the navigation contains mostly internal or placeholder URLs, suggesting a hastily assembled site lacking legitimate social proof or contact options; (4) SSL certificate issues indicating possible security problems; (5) site structure and product list mimic but do not match typical legitimate e-commerce websites; (6) no clear, professional customer service contact method. These factors align with typical fake online shopping scams, designed to appear legitimate while lacking transparency, reliability, and proper consumer protections.
